research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Thomas Magnete is focused on developing advanced electrohydraulic actuator systems and components for automotive and mobile hydraulics applications. Their research includes electrohydraulic actuators with hydraulic valves and electrical coils, enhancing fluid control precision. They also explore valve assemblies with movable sliders for variable fluid flow adjustment, and proportional valves with pressure-balanced seat slides for improved performance. Additionally, they are working on coil devices for solenoid valves and actuators, emphasizing electromagnetic and fluidic actuator systems.

product.name: Mobility Solutions
product.description: Thomas Magnete provides systems for both electrified and conventional drives, focusing on dynamics, environmental friendliness, efficiency, and safety.

product.name: Off Highway Solutions
product.description: The company offers electrified systems for electro-hydraulic control, including valves, blocks, and mechatronic systems for precise regulation of work hydraulics, pumps, and clutches.

product.name: Smart Motor Pump Units
product.description: These units are developed for fully active chassis systems, enhancing vehicle suspension and shock absorber coordination, crucial for electric vehicles and autonomous driving.

product.name: ePowertrain Solutions
product.description: Thomas Magnete develops system solutions for the electric powertrain, addressing mechanical, thermal, and electromagnetic requirements, used in automatic transmissions and battery cooling systems.
